name: ptv-mcp
description: Departures, journey planning and live delays for Melbourne trains, trams and buses.
long_description:
Answers transport questions from Victoria's published GTFS feed and, with an optional key, the GTFS-Realtime feeds.

The timetable works with no credential at all. Adding a realtime key turns scheduled times into live ones: how late each service is running, current disruptions, and a warning when delays have broken a connection you were relying on.

On first run the extension downloads the timetable feed and builds a local index. This takes a few minutes and happens once; the tools report progress while it runs. Everything after that is answered locally.

tools.name: find_stop
tools.description: Find a station or stop by name and return its id

tools.name: next_departures
tools.description: Upcoming departures from a stop, with live delays

tools.name: plan_trip
tools.description: Journeys between two stops, direct or with one change

tools.name: last_service
tools.description: Services still to depart tonight, including after midnight

tools.name: service_alerts
tools.description: Current disruptions and how late each line is running

tools.name: stops_near
tools.description: Stops near a point, grouped by mode

tools.name: compare_departure_stops
tools.description: Which nearby stop reaches a destination soonest, and by which mode

tools.name: leg_calls
tools.description: Every station a leg calls at, and the ones it runs through

tools.name: database_status
tools.description: How old the local timetable database is, and whether it has gone stale

tools.name: rebuild_database
tools.description: Rebuild the timetable database from the published feed, in the background

realtime_key.title: Realtime API key
realtime_key.description: Optional. Adds live delays, cancellations and disruption alerts. Free and self-service at opendata.transport.vic.gov.au. Without it you get the published timetable only.
